title: A flex scanner, then the bison calculator
description: Build the tutorial scanner and calculator, then run their sample inputs. Compiler versions and build diagnostics are sample output.

setup: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq flex bison >/dev/null

files.Makefile:
# Makefile for the calculator

CC      = gcc
CFLAGS  = -Wall -g
LDFLAGS = -lfl -lm

calc: calc.tab.c lex.yy.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o calc calc.tab.c lex.yy.c $(LDFLAGS)

calc.tab.c calc.tab.h: calc.y
	bison -d calc.y           # -d generates the header file calc.tab.h

lex.yy.c: calc.l calc.tab.h
	flex calc.l

clean:
	rm -f calc calc.tab.c calc.tab.h lex.yy.c
